description: The full tactica. Case File for one fixture: the forecast, the score grid (exact-score chances), the evidence used and what drove the forecast. Use this when you need the reasoning or score-level detail. Use get_match_forecast instead for the headline chances only (cheaper), or get_betting_picks for recommended bets. Read-only; the latest Case File for the fixture. Paid: 1.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

name: get_case_file
title: Get a match Case File
